corroborating_length.note: Length alone EXCLUDES nothing: the shortest possible threefold needs 8 plies and the book is 16 plies long, so a 16-ply book could in principle contain one. The exclusion comes from the graph being acyclic, not from its depth.

verdict: NO REPETITION OR FIFTY-MOVE DRAW IS REACHABLE IN BOOK: the position graph over all 2429 reachable positions and 2616 book edges is acyclic (DFS finds no back edge, and the checker detects a planted A->B->A), so no book line can revisit a position and a threefold cannot arise while in book; the fifty-move counter starts at 0 and no book line is 100 plies long (longest is 16).
